action.objective: Commit verified f4f5, gaining space and restricting the black king toward the edge.
action.rationale: f4f5 is the sole commit_ready move: exact depth-4 score 1797, complete safety probe (no mate-in-one reply, no checking-reply refutation), and no Black captures available. Broad depth-4 search found it top with exact bound, and single-candidate verification reproduced 1797 with PV f4f5 Kh7 Rh4+ Kg7. The f5 pawn attacks e6/g6 and is supported by the d4/c2 pawn structure, squeezing the black king. a3a4 (1785) is inferior. No replan triggers, so commit directly.
